instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In an outdoor European street with blurred white buildings, the blonde woman in the gray turtleneck (R1) stands on the left, facing right with a warm smile. Opposite her, the man in the tan corduroy jacket (R2) stands on the right, facing left and smiling back. The man (R2) gently places his hand on the shoulder of the blonde woman (R1) as they share a close, affectionate moment. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight, creating a natural and warm color palette.
